A '''Kommerken steak''' was a hearty slice of meat and a type of [[Steak/Legends|steak]]<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=item|Kommerken Steak}}</ref> that was often served with [[ootoowerg]]s.<ref name="sotme" /> It was a favorite dish of many throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SWG" />

When [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] visited [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]], they ordered such a meal in a restaurant.<ref name="sotme" />

{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:KommerkenSteakSWG.jpg|220px|thumb|Kommerken steak served alongside a vegetable]]
Kommerken steak appeared as a consumable food in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It could be created by players of the Domestics Trader profession and when eaten, gave the player a bonus when they foraged.
